Class DataManagementController

java.lang.Object
com.konbini.controller.DataManagementController
public class DataManagementController extends Object
Controller responsible for managing data operations including saving, loading, and initializing sample data for products, customers, and transactions.

  • Method Details

    • handleSaveData

      public void handleSaveData()
      Saves all data (products, customers, transactions) to persistent storage. Displays appropriate success/error messages based on the operation results.

    • handleLoadData

      public void handleLoadData()
      Loads all data (products, customers, transactions) from persistent storage. Provides user-friendly messages for first-time use when no data exists.

    • initializeSampleData

      public void initializeSampleData()
      Initializes sample data for the application including sample products and customers. Only initializes data if no existing data is found to avoid overwriting. Automatically saves the initialized data to persistent storage.
